title: Käthe-Kollwitz-Straße, Mannheim
description:
Welcome to your stylish retreat! ✨🏡

This studio offers a proper combination of lots of light 🌞, warm woods and bright color accents 🎨, which together with high-quality materials create an inviting ambience. Every detail, from the desk 🖥️  to the shelves, has been individually designed and crafted to make your everyday life easier.

🔹 Ideal for students 🎓, this room offers not only functionality but also a modern design that extends into the kitchen. Enjoy cooking on the glass ceramic hob and experience the convenience of hansgrohe fittings. The bed with an additional 10 cm in width 🛏️ and generous storage space underneath allows for restful nights and optimal use of the space.

⚠️  Important Remark: The toilet 🚽 is private but outside the room.

🌟 Special highlight: Your private single bathroom 🚿 is on the same floor and accessible only with your personal transponder – no waiting, no shared facilities, just privacy!

🛋️ Additional perks:
✅ Pantry kitchen & fridge/freezer 
✅ 43-inch 4K UHD LED Smart TV 
✅ Comfortable workspace 
✅ Exclusive deal with dean&david for catering 

👕 Laundry made easy: Use the washing machine & dryer in the common area whenever needed.

Welcome to your new studio - where functionality meets design and your student life takes on a new quality! 🚀

title: Käthe-Kollwitz-Straße, Mannheim
description:

Our Superior Apartments offer top-quality living with a design tailored to your needs. Modular storage furniture 🏠, warm wood tones, and clever work & living spaces 💡 come together with colorful details and cool materials to create an inspiring atmosphere.

🏠 Welcome to your Superior Apartment – where design meets functionality and student life reaches a new level! 🚀

title: Bürgermeister-Fuchs-Straße, Mannheim
description:
Discover “The Green Room”: your private retreat in a bright, fully renovated 110 m2 apartment in Neckarstadt, Mannheim.

Ideal for (grad) students or early-career professionals: enjoy fast 500 Mb/s fiber internet, modern kitchen & bath, shared with just 2–3 like-minded guests.

Close to transit & essentials: 5 minutes' walk to the tram stop or supermarket. Bike-sharing station just around the corner. Your cozy, secure, long-term home away from home.

Your private room offers:

☑️Spacious queen-size bed with quality linens;

☑️Large desk & ergonomic chair—perfect for focused study or work;

☑️Generous wardrobe; blackout roller shutters; triple-glazed windows; insect screens; LED bedside lamps.

Shared spaces include a fully equipped modern kitchen (induction hob, oven, dishwasher, coffee & tea essentials), a clean bathroom with bath/shower, separate WC, and a hallway connecting all rooms.

☑️Your private room is lockable from the inside for your security and privacy.

☑️Shared access to kitchen, bathroom, WC, hallway.

☑️High-speed fiber-optic WiFi (500 Mb/s) throughout.

☑️All shared appliances: laundry machine, dryer, dishwasher, kitchen fully equipped for cooking & baking.

I can be reached via HousingAnywhere, (hidden) or call. I'm happy to give tips on restaurants, public transportation, and supermarkets.

Etiquette in common areas: Please clean up immediately after use, wash cooking utensils thoroughly, clean surfaces, and ventilate well after use (especially after showering and cooking).

The common areas are professionally cleaned approximately every two weeks; in between, all guests are expected to keep these areas clean.

Registration: WGB can be provided.

Smoking is not permitted. Violations may result in a fee of €500 plus the cost of repairing any damage.
Unfortunately, we cannot accept guests who'd spend several hours a day gaming and bring their own PC equipment for that purpose.

No pets allowed.

All guests are responsible for keeping their own rooms and the common areas tidy.

title: Juteweg, Mannheim
description:
Beautiful, bright furnished 1 room apartment in Mannheim Sandhofen for rent.

Equipment:
Box spring bed
Smart TV
WiFi
Kitchenette with cutlery and dishes
Fridge with freezer compartment
Microwave with grill function
Nespresso coffee machine
toaster
Kettle
iron
ironing board
Vacuum cleaner
Bed linen + towels
Washing machine + dryer in the basement for shared use
Free street parking
1 minute to the next tram stop

Additional Information
Tram, bakery, restaurants just a few minutes walk away.

Smoking is not allowed in the apartment, but is allowed in front of the house.
